summary.text: Kevin Volk, a Democrat, has represented District 17 in the Arizona House of Representatives since January 13, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Tucson, Arizona, graduated from Salpointe High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Brown University.

His career experience includes working as a fifth-grade teacher, serving as an English language instructor in Mexico through a Fulbright scholarship, working as a real estate agent, and founding a small business focused on affordable prefabricated housing.
